fieldData.name: How to Find an Apartment with an Attached Garage
fieldData.seo-title: Apartments with Attached Garages: Cost by City, EV Charging, Insurance Savings (2026)
fieldData.meta-description: Apartments with attached garages are rare but available in suburbs of Houston, Dallas, Phoenix, Austin, and Denver. Here is how to find them, what they cost, and what to budget in 2026.
fieldData.post-summary: Apartments with attached garages are rental units where a private, enclosed garage connects directly to the interior of the home, allowing you to walk from your car into your living space without stepping outside. These units make up a small fraction of total rental inventory, concentrated in suburban townhouse communities and build-to-rent neighborhoods across the Sun Belt and Midwest.
